info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Investment Portfolio Statements-v2-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Statements Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of investment portfolio statements. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of current and historical statements, empowering financial institutions and investors to monitor and analyze portfolio performance over time. Typical consumers include asset managers, financial analysts, and investment platforms seeking to provide users with detailed insights into their investment activities. With this API, businesses can enhance their reporting capabilities and improve decision-making based on accurate financial data.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the statements associated with their portfolio. The statements provide detailed insights into the performance and allocations of assets within the portfolio.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve portfolio statements. It must contain relevant fields as specified in the schema.

ListInvestmentPortfolioStatementsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on portfolio statements. It is expected to be a string.

audit.description: Audit information related to the operation.

ListInvestmentPortfolioStatementsRespons.description: Response schema for the successful retrieval of portfolio statements.
